name: IIDOn

args.name: xs
args.description: The set of keys identifying the draws

title: Independent draws indexed by keys
examples: ~IIDOn({1,2,3},Normal(0,1))  # A map of three independent draws
description: Draws one value from dist for each key in xs, returning a map with those keys. Draws are independent conditional on any shared random parameters of dist. Density evaluation requires exactly the same keys.
